title: Leidos Lands $95M DLA Contract to Apply AI to Asset Management
script:
Leidos just secured a ninety-five million dollar contract from the Defense Logistics Agency.
They are tasked with applying AI to improve enterprise asset management for the agency.
This initiative enhances supply chain visibility and readiness across the entire logistics network.
Leidos will provide technical support to modernize legacy information technology infrastructure.
The contract includes a one-year base period plus four additional option years.
It aims to streamline how the agency tracks and maintains critical military equipment.
Will this AI overhaul finally fix defense inventory tracking?

LINE 7: Replace 'Will this AI overhaul finally fix defense inventory tracking?' with 'Can Leidos' AI solve the DLA's long-standing inventory visibility issues?'
